item.description:
Many orders for the same product at the same moment. Run "0. Setup" first.

Sets the stock of race_product_id to race_stock, sends race_requests orders of 1 unit in parallel, and checks that exactly race_stock succeed and the stock never goes below 0. Then it cancels those orders and restores the original stock.

Note: php artisan serve uses one worker by default and handles requests one by one. For a real race, start it with PHP_CLI_SERVER_WORKERS greater than 1.

exec: pm.test("The Warehouse answered (stock is not null)", () => pm.expect(stock).to.be.a("number"));
